== Tracks ==
* Music and sound tracks run on the film's time, with fades and volume keys.
* '''Sync to clip audio''' lines a track up with the clip's own sound.
* Audio can be imported from a link.

== Master music ==
In a clip's '''Audio''' panel (Shoot screen), '''★''' star the track the edit should follow — or leave it on the clip's own sound. A song imported into a clip's Audio panel is its master music without needing a ★.

On the Edit, shots land on the music — see [[Rexy 360: Editing#Shots on the music|Editing]].

== Audio → Move ==
'''Audio → Move…''' makes moves that '''pulse on the beat''' or '''follow the loudness''' of any track. Layers can be stacked and trimmed on the timeline, with '''Threshold''' and '''Smooth''' controls.

Saving a move can apply the music to it, so the music-driven movement travels to another clip.
